{{Top|leg}}
'''Tayaba'I''' was the winter equinox on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] which lasted for seventy-two [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. During the Tayaba'I, the planet's temperature dropped, turning Socorro frosty. With the temperature at its lowest, the majority of the [[chiru]] population died off, allowing the next generation of eggs to hatch as the planet warmed back up.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
